blocks.text: Profiling aur optimization program ki raftar (speed) aur karkardagi (efficiency) behtar karte hain. Profiling napti hai ke code ka har hissa kitna waqt aur kitne wasail (resources, jaise memory) leta hai. Optimization sust ya zyada wasail lene wale hisson ko tez banane par tawajjo deti hai. Tez (high-performance) applications banane ke liye yeh tareeqe zaroori hain. Baqaida profiling se code barhne ke saath bhi achha chalta rehta hai.

blocks.title: Do You Know? (kya aap jante hain?)
blocks.text: Profiling program ke sust hisse pehchanne mein madad deti hai taake behtar performance ke liye unhein theek kiya ja sake.
Neeche wala code nested loop (loop ke andar loop) dikhata hai:

blocks.title: Code Explanation (Wazahat)
blocks.text:
"for i in range(10000):": bahar wala loop; i 0 se 9999 tak jata hai, yani 10,000 chakkar.
"for j in range(10000):": andar wala loop; bahar wale ke har chakkar mein yeh poore 10,000 chakkar lagata hai.
"# Some repeated task" comment hai, aur "pass" kuch nahi karta; sirf us jagah ko bharta hai jahan asal kaam hota.
Output: kuch print nahi hota. Lekin pass 10,000 x 10,000 = 100,000,000 dafa chalta hai, is liye aam computer par yeh program kai second leta hai. Isi liye is ko Run ka button nahi diya gaya; neeche "Khud chala kar dekhein" mein is ka chhota version hai.
Is code mein bahar wala loop 10,000 dafa chalta hai. Bahar wale loop ke har chakkar mein andar wala loop bhi 10,000 dafa chalta hai. Is liye kul (total) dafa:

Yani andar wala statement das karor (one hundred million) dafa chal sakta hai, jis se program bohat sust ho sakta hai. Code ka aisa hissa performance bottleneck (rukawat) kehlata hai. Profiling tools programmers ko yeh sust hisse dhoondne mein madad dete hain taake code optimise kar ke program ki karkardagi behtar ki ja sake.
Kitab ka 10000 x 10000 wala loop bohat lamba hai; yahan wahi khayal chhote n ke saath. n badal kar Run karein aur dekhein ke kaam n x n ki raftar se barhta hai.

n = 300   # har loop kitni dafa chale

count = 0
for i in range(n):
    for j in range(n):
        count = count + 1   # andar wala kaam
print("Andar wala kaam", count, "dafa chala")
print("n x n =", n * n)

blocks.title: Code Explanation (Wazahat)
blocks.text:
"n = 300": har loop ke chakkar.
"for i in range(n):" aur andar "for j in range(n):": bahar ke har chakkar mein andar wala loop poore n chakkar lagata hai.
"count = count + 1": andar wala kaam kitni dafa hua, gin raha hai.
Output: "Andar wala kaam 90000 dafa chala" aur "n x n = 90000".
Khud try karein: n = 600 (dugna) kar dein: kaam 360000 dafa, yani chaar guna. Isi liye nested loops jaldi bottleneck ban jate hain.

items: Profiling: har hisse ka waqt aur wasail napna; optimization: sust hisse tez karna.
